posts.body:
Temple Of Sacrifice (Puzzle game)​
A puzzle game where you explore a temple and solve 80 differente puzzles.
As Mr John Explo Rer you are sent to the temple of sacrifice. An illusive temple in the middle of the jungle that is said the contain a jewel with the power of the elements. But to reach it, you need to solve it's trials.
- Use your HP as a ressource to solve 80 different puzzles
- An semi-open ended adventure where you can tackle puzzles in any order you feel confortable
- Each area is based on one of the four elements and each has its own gimmick
- Each elemental area has 2 different areas in themselves, with varying difficulty levels
- Around 2 to 4 hours of gameplay
The game is only available in "itch.io" for $3 for now, but I hope to add it to steam latter on.
